English:
Arrival Log, Entry 1

We have emerged from the mysterious anomaly intact, but crippled. My helmsman tells me that we are no longer in the Milky Way galaxy, but rather somewhere in the Andromeda galaxy. Our ship is on emergency power, and we have been separated from the rest of the fleet. I have diverted what power we can spare to the CryoPods in hopes that they will continue to function until we can meet back with the fleet.  We have began broadcasting a distress signal, in hopes that the rest of the fleet will receive it. I hope any aliens that might pick up our signal are friendly, or else we will definitely be in trouble.

-Captain Branson
Chinese (simplified):
抵达日志，条目 1

我们已从神秘的异常中完整地浮现，但已残破不堪。我的舵手告诉我，我们已不再身处银河系，而是在仙女座星系中的某处。我们的飞船仅靠紧急动力运行，且已与舰队的其他部分分离。我将尽可能多的剩余电力转移至低温休眠舱，希望它们能持续运转直至我们与舰队重新会合。我们已开始广播求救信号，希望舰队的其他成员能接收到。我希望任何可能截获我们信号的外星人是友好的，否则我们必将陷入麻烦。

——布兰森船长

With just me and Engineer Flores alive, I plan on making the best of the situation and seeing if we can find the Cargo Module to at least recover the cargo we lost. Perhaps there’s something in there, or elsewhere on this Junkyard of a planet, that can help us contact the fleet.

-Captain Branson

抵达日志，条目 3

不知何故，金牛座号在坠毁中幸免于爆炸。我们在进入大气层前只弹射了两个附属模块，其中之一是货物舱。为什么布罗科维奇医生决定丢弃货物舱，而不是丢弃一个低温模块来拯救更多乘客，我无法解释。我会问他，但他和舵手都没能在坠毁中幸存。
只有我和工程师弗洛雷斯还活着，我计划充分利用现状，看看能否找到货物舱，至少找回我们丢失的货物。也许里面有什么东西，或者在这个垃圾场星球的其他地方，有东西能帮助我们联系舰队。

-布兰森船长

English:
Engineering Log, Entry 2

At the Captain's request, I have set up a solar-powered capacitor that should allow the Taurus to maintain power indefinitely, unless someone intentionally sabotages it. Hopefully, this will keep the remaining CryoPods active, despite the damage to the ship. 
This world is a Trash Heap, an Engineer's playground filled with old wrecks and some that we might be able to repair. Perhaps I can find us a new Capital Vessel to repair, and take us off this planet to find the rest of the fleet.

-Engineer Flores
Chinese (simplified):
工程日志，条目 2

应船长要求，我建立了一个太阳能电容，应该能让金牛座号保持无限期供电，除非有人故意破坏它。希望这能保持剩余的低温舱室激活，尽管飞船已损坏。
这个世界是个垃圾堆，一个工程师的游乐场，布满旧残骸，有些我们也许能修复。或许我能找到一艘新的主力舰来修复，带我们离开这个星球，去寻找舰队其他成员。

English:
Medical Log, Entry 2

Things are getting out of control. When the aliens attacked, they damaged the cargo module, which, In addition to all our valuable cargo, contains all of my medical specimens. While they are still in cryo-stasis, their survival is more important than my own.
If anyone retrieves this log, try to access cargo container J7. It contains my medical specimens and a copy of my research detailing how their... secretions... can be used to create a medical ointment.

-Doctor Vlach
Chinese (simplified):
医疗日志，条目 2

事态正在失控。当外星人攻击时，他们损坏了货物舱，里面不仅有我们所有贵重货物，还有我所有的医学标本。虽然它们仍在低温休眠中，但它们的生存比我的更重要。
如果有人取回这份日志，请尝试访问货物容器 J7。里面装有我的医学标本和一份研究副本，详细说明了如何利用它们的……分泌物……来制作药膏。

English:
Medical Log, Entry 1

My Cryo Chamber's emergency systems activated and woke me from Cryo Stasis early, nearly two hundred years early, according to the ship's chronometer. However, scans of the local star formations apparently indicate we're NOT at our intended destination. 

I've woken up the rest of the flight crew, in hopes that we can locate the rest of the fleet, who were not within scanning range. The helmsman says we're in the Andromeda Galaxy, and that according to current star positions, it's been nearly 600 years after we left Earth. I'm not sure what to make of it, but I know the Captain will figure it out.

-Doctor Vlach
Chinese (simplified):
医疗日志，条目 1

我的低温舱紧急系统提前激活，将我早早地从低温休眠中唤醒——根据飞船计时器，提前了近两百年。然而，对本地星群的扫描似乎表明我们并未到达预定目的地。

我已经唤醒了其他飞行船员，希望我们能找到舰队其他成员，他们不在扫描范围内。舵手说我们在仙女座星系，而且根据当前恒星位置，我们离开地球已近600年。我不确定该如何理解，但我知道船长会弄明白的。

-弗拉克医生

English:
Engineering Log, Entry 1

The mysterious anomaly we traversed seems to have drained most of the ship's power. The Captain had me divert what little power we have left to the Cryo Chambers. We set course toward what appears to be a Temperate planet, in hopes that others from our fleet will do the same, if they're even nearby. I've tried to convince the Captain that we should land and try to revive as many of the passengers as we can, but he insists on trying to contact the fleet by sending out a distress signal. I hope his adherence to regulations doesn't get us killed.
-Engineer Flores
Chinese (simplified):
工程日志，条目 1

我们穿越的神秘异常似乎耗尽了飞船大部分能量。船长让我将仅剩的能量转至低温舱。我们朝着一个温带星球设定航线，希望我们舰队中的其他飞船也会这么做——如果它们就在附近的话。我曾试图说服船长，我们应该降落并尽可能多地唤醒乘客，但他坚持要发出求救信号来联系舰队。我希望他遵守规定不会害死我们。
-工程师弗洛雷斯

English:
Helmsman Log, Entry 1

When I signed up for this mission I thought it might give me a chance at starting a new life on a distant planet. I never thought it would take me this far. We're beyond the reaches that any human has gone before, at least as far as they had when we left, but it seems we're here much quicker than should be possible. 

According to the ship's sensor logs, we've traveled through some sort of spacio-temporal anomaly that brought us to the Andromeda Galaxy in a mere 600 years. Although we've apparently only been in Cryo Stasis for about 4 months. 

-Ensign Jargalsaikhan, Helmsman
Chinese (simplified):
舵手日志，条目 1

当我报名参加这个任务时，我以为它或许能让我有机会在遥远星球上开始新生活。我从没想过会走这么远。我们已经超越了任何人类曾到达的范围——至少在我们出发时他们是那么远——但我们似乎比预期快得多地到达了这里。

根据飞船传感器日志，我们穿越了某种时空异常，这让我们在短短600年内到达了仙女座星系。尽管我们显然只在低温休眠中过了大约4个月。

The ship that found us was of an unknown alien design. They opened fire on us as soon as they were in range. We're heading toward an Arid planet nearby, hoping to evade our pursuers. I have ordered that the attached Cryo Modules be ejected, so that if we don't make it, perhaps our passengers can survive.

-Captain Earling

找到我们的飞船属于未知的外星设计。它们一进入射程就向我们开火。我们正朝附近一颗干旱星球前进，希望能躲避追击者。我已命令将附属的低温舱弹射出去，这样如果我们没能成功，也许我们的乘客能够幸存。

English:
Arrival Log, Entry 1

After emergingfrom the mysterious anomaly, Doctor Bonilla revived the rest of the flight crew. Ensign Caplin has determined that the anomaly has, somehow, transported us overtwo and a half million light years into the Andromeda Galaxy. 

Our ship’s chronometersays that we’ve only been in stasis for around four months. However, based onstar and galaxy positions, our computer has calculated that it’s been around600 years since we left Earth. I’m not sure how to explain this discrepancyother than the anomaly somehow transported us through time as well.

In addition to all that, we don't seem to have emerged in the same location as the rest of the fleet. I'm not sure if it's a good idea, but I plan on activating our distress beacon, hoping that the fleet isn't too far away to receive it.

-Captain Earling

到达日志，记录1

从神秘异常中浮现后，博尼利亚医生唤醒了其余飞行机组人员。卡普林少尉确定，这个异常以某种方式将我们传送到了超过二百五十万光年外的仙女座星系。

我们飞船的计时器显示我们只休眠了大约四个月。然而，基于恒星和星系的坐标，我们的计算机计算出自从我们离开地球已经过去了大约600年。我不太确定如何解释这个差异，除了那个异常也以某种方式让我们穿越了时间。

除此之外，我们似乎没有与舰队其他成员出现在同一位置。我不确定这是否是个好主意，但我计划启动我们的求救信标，希望舰队不会太远而无法收到。

——厄灵舰长

English:
Arrival Log, Entry 3

All the Cryo Modules have been ejected. The alien ship has sent drones to follow them, but two of them are on trajectory for the planet. Hopefully, they will survive the crash, and someone will eventually come out of cryo stasis. The planet registers as habitable, if a little on the hot end, so theyy have a chance, unlike us. 
My last act was to order the rest of the flight crew onto Cryo Module 3, one of the two Modules with Oxygen Suits. They were supplied with the Auxiliary Ventilator and all the Emergency Rations we could find, giving them the best chance possible. Hopefully, the alien ship will continue to follow me, and they can somehow evade the drones.

-Captain Earling

到达日志，记录3

所有低温舱已弹射。那艘外星飞船派出无人机追踪它们，但其中两个正朝着星球轨迹运行。希望它们能坠毁幸存，有人最终能从低温休眠中苏醒。该星球记录为适宜居住，虽然稍微偏热，所以他们有机会，不像我们。

English:
Engineering Log, Entry 1

The ship weathered the effects of the anomaly remarkably well. With little damage and only minor power drain, we should be able to initiate warp and begin looking for the rest of the fleet. If they fared as well as we did, perhaps we can regroup and possibly begin our colony here. We may not be in the same galaxy as we started, but we don't have much choice.

工程日志，条目 1

English:
Engineering Log, Entry 2

The alien ship continues to pursue us. I've been taxing the engines as much as possible without overloading them, but we can't keep it up for much longer. The Captain says he has a plan to keep them off our backs, but I have a feeling he's not telling us everything. 

He's ordered me to move the auxiliary ventilator and a few crates of cargo into Cryo Module 3. I think he's planning on having us use the Module as an escape pod. It's not a bad idea, if we can trick the aliens into following the Leo, instead of the Cryo Module.

-Engineer Cardenas
Chinese (simplified):
工程日志，条目 2

外星飞船仍在追我们。我一直尽可能让引擎超负荷运转而不至于过载，但我们撑不了多久了。船长说他有办法甩掉他们，但我感觉他没把一切都告诉我们。

他命令我把辅助通风机和几箱货物搬到低温休眠模块3。我猜他是想让我们用那个模块作为逃生舱。如果我们能骗外星人跟踪利奥号而不是低温休眠模块，这倒是个不错的主意。

- 工程师卡德纳斯

English:
Medical Log, Entry 2

It's official, this galaxy hates us. Not only did the distress call draw in a hostile alien ship, but the only habitable planet nearby is barely that. Parched mountains, rugged savanna, grueling plains, and shriveled lake-beds with the remains of once thriving plant and animal life, all make this planet a hostile environment. Even the radiation levels on the planet are well above tolerable, and a toxin in the atmosphere makes the air unbreathable. I would not want to be stuck here.

-Doctor Bonilla
Chinese (simplified):
医疗日志，条目 2

确定了，这个星系和我们有仇。不仅求救信号引来了敌意外星飞船，而且附近唯一可居住的星球也只是勉强算得上。干涸的山脉、崎岖的稀树草原、严酷的平原，以及曾经繁茂的动植物遗骸构成的干涸湖床，所有这些都让这颗星球成为环境恶劣之地。就连星球上的辐射水平也远超可承受范围，大气中的某种毒素使得空气无法呼吸。我可不想被困在这里。

- 博尼利亚医生

English:
Medical Log, Entry 1

It seems all the Cryo Chambers have survived the voyage through the anomaly. If we manage to locate the rest of the fleet, we will be in great shape to set up a new colony, if we can find a habitable planet.

Let's just hope the distress call the Captain wants to send out can get their attention, without drawing the attention of any... hostile entities.

-Doctor Bonilla
Chinese (simplified):
医疗日志，条目 1

所有低温休眠舱似乎都平安渡过了异常之旅。如果我们能找到舰队其余部分，就能在找到宜居星球后很好地建立新殖民地。

- 博尼利亚医生

English:
Helmsman Log, Entry 1

It appears that, in addition to catapulting us into another galaxy, and through time, but also increased the distance between each ship in the fleet during the journey. After calculating exactly how far we traveled, I was able to get an approximate location of each ship. 

It seems that several of the smaller ships, like ours, may have emerged in systems not too far from where we did. Unfortunately, the Merryweather and the Bonneville have apparently ended up a lot further away.

-Ensign Caplin, Helmsman
Chinese (simplified):
舵手日志，条目 1

我计算了穿越异常的轨迹，并与航行期间传感器日志进行了对比。看来，这次穿越不仅将我们抛向另一个星系，还穿越了时间，同时加大了舰队中各飞船在航行过程中的距离。在精确计算出我们航行了多远之后，我得以大致确定每艘飞船的位置。

似乎有几艘和我们差不多的小型飞船可能出现在离我们不太远的星系中。不幸的是，梅里韦瑟号和邦纳维尔号显然最终落到了更远的地方。

English:
Medical Log, Entry 1

We've emerged from the anomaly, and I've woken up the Flight Crew. The Captain seems to be he usual optimistic self, although I would not be as optimistic myself, were it not for the fact that we seem to be in, more or less, one piece. The only thing that has me worried is that the rest of the UE fleet has not arrived where we did.

It appears we're going to be here alone for a while. Seeing as the Fukushima and the Merryweather were the only ships carrying legitimate medical facilities, I had to make due with what I had. I've used some left over scraps of medical equipment we had lying around to put together a Ramshackle Healing Station. It's not as useful as a full Medic Station, no built in Emergency Teleporter, but it will slowly heal someone inside.

-Doctor Schneider

医疗日志，条目1

我们已经从异常中出来，我叫醒了飞行组。船长还是他惯常的乐观态度，而我自己也乐观不起来，要不是我们大体上还算完整的话。唯一让我担心的是UE舰队的其他部分没有到达我们所在的地方。

看来我们要独自在这里待一段时间了。考虑到福岛号和梅里韦瑟号是仅有的携带正规医疗设施的飞船，我只能凑合使用手头的材料。我用我们周围剩下的医疗设备碎片拼凑了一个简陋的治疗站。它不如完整的医疗站有用，没有内置的紧急传送器，但可以缓慢治疗里面的人。

English:
Engineering Log, Entry 3

There's not much point in keeping these logs. I doubt anyone will find them. But on the off chance that someone does, There's something you should know.
One of the cargo containers in Cargo Module One contains a Teleporter. It' doesn't have much power, but it might get you to the surface of the planet. I would use it myself, but Captain Dominguez has just ejected it to keep the aliens from getting to it.

If you manage to get an Oxygen Suit, perhaps you can jetpack over to it. If you do, remember the Activation Switch Code: 1899
I don't stand much of a chance against these aliens, but perhaps someone with combat experience will awaken and take back the ship. Good Luck.

-Engineer Vaughn
Chinese (simplified):
工程日志，条目3

保留这些日志没什么意义。我怀疑没人会找到它们。但万一有人找到了，有些事情你应该知道。
货舱模块一中的一个货物容器里有一个传送器。它电量不多，但也许能把你送到星球表面。我自己想用它，但多明戈斯船长刚刚把它弹射出去，以防止外星人得到它。

如果你能弄到氧气防护服，也许可以用喷气背包飞到它那里。如果成功了，记住激活开关密码：1899
我对付这些外星人没什么机会，但也许有战斗经验的人会苏醒并夺回飞船。祝你好运。

English:
Engineering Log, Entry 2

The Captain has me pushing the engines as hard as I can to get to this distress signal our sensors detected. Ensign Neibuhr has analyzed the signal and, somehow, it appears to be a genuine distress signal on a United Earth frequency.

The only reasoning I can come up with is that it's one of the other UE Ships, but if it is, why aren't they sending out their contact ID along with it? That's standard protocol. There shouldn't be anyone else from Earth in this galaxy, even after six hundred years I doubt that humans could have traveled this far. But then again, we did.

-Engineer Vaughn
Chinese (simplified):
工程日志，条目2

船长让我尽可能用力推动引擎，以便到达传感器探测到的这个求救信号。尼布尔少尉分析了信号，不知怎的，它似乎是联合地球频率上的一个真实求救信号。

我能想到的唯一解释是这是其他UE飞船之一，但如果是这样，为什么他们不一起发送自己的联系ID？那是标准协议。这个星系不应该有来自地球的其他任何人，即使过了六百年，我也不认为人类能旅行这么远。但话说回来，我们做到了。

——沃恩工程师

English:
Engineering Log, Entry 1

I am amazed at how well the ship held up through the anomaly. We suffered very little hull damage, and what internal damage we did suffer was easily repairable. Captain Dominguez has decided to begin searching for a place where we, and hopefully all the other UE Ships, can set up our colony. I have my reservations about pushing the engines so hard just after emerging from the anomaly, but as long as we don't go too far in one jump, we should be fine.

-Engineer Vaughn
Chinese (simplified):
工程日志，条目1

我很惊讶飞船在异常中竟然保持得如此完好。我们只受到了很少的船体损伤，而内部损伤也容易修复。多明戈斯船长决定开始寻找一个地方，让我们以及希望所有其他UE飞船能够建立殖民地。我对刚从异常中出来就如此大力推动引擎有所保留，但只要一次跳跃不要太远，我们应该没问题。

——沃恩工程师

English:
Arrival Log, Entry 3
We should have never answered that damned distress signal. As soon as we entered orbit around the snow planet, we were ambushed by three alien vessels. They immediately took out one of our engines, and the bridge. Fortunately, Ensign Neibuhr saw them coming and evacuated the bridge before it was destroyed.

We'll do what we can to fight them, but it seems that the distress signal coming from the planet's surface was nothing but a trap. How they got a United Earth distress signal is beyond me, unless they captured one of the other UE Ships of our fleet, not that it matters now. If  we could have only made it to the planet, perhaps we could have stood a chance..

-Captain Dominguez
Chinese (simplified):
到达日志，条目3
我们当初就不该回应那个该死的求救信号。我们刚进入雪星球轨道，就遭到了三艘外星飞船的伏击。他们立即摧毁了我们的一台引擎和舰桥。幸运的是，尼布尔少尉看到了他们的到来，在舰桥被毁前疏散了人员。

我们会尽力反击，但似乎来自星球表面的求救信号不过是个陷阱。他们是如何获得联合地球的求救信号的，我实在想不通，除非他们捕获了我们舰队中的另一艘UE飞船，不过现在这已经不重要了。要是我们能成功降落到星球上，或许还有机会……

——多明戈斯船长

English:
Arrival Log, Entry 2

While searching for a suitable planet, our sensors detected a signal coming from a nearby Planet. While the planet has a harsh, frozen environment, it seems the signal is on a UE frequency. However, it seems that the specific signal is a generic distress call not currently in use by any ship in the fleet.

If the signal IS a United Earth distress call, it seems to be from a ship that would have been launched over a hundred years after we left. Upon further review of galactic positions, it seems that we have traveled not only to another galaxy, but another time. I'm ordering Engineer Vaughn to push the engines as hard as he believes is safe, @w1 so that we can get to the planet as quickly as possible to try and solve this mystery.

-Captain Dominguez
Chinese (simplified):
到达日志，条目2

在寻找合适星球的过程中，我们的传感器探测到附近一个星球发出的信号。虽然该星球环境严酷、冰封，但信号似乎是UE频率。然而，这个特定信号是一个通用的求救信号，当前舰队中没有飞船在使用。

如果这个信号确实是联合地球的求救信号，那么它似乎来自一艘在我们离开后一百多年才发射的飞船。进一步查看星系位置后，我们似乎不仅穿越到了另一个星系，还穿越到了另一个时代。我命令沃恩工程师在他认为安全的范围内尽可能加大引擎推力，@w1 以便我们尽快抵达该星球，尝试解开这个谜团。

English:
Arrival Log, Entry 1

The mysterious anomaly that sent us here seems to either only be one-way, have collapsed, or be a mobile anomaly. There's no sign of it on our sensors, so it looks like our chances of returning to our galaxy are not good.

With that in mind, I have decided to begin looking for a good location to set up a new colony, while keeping our sensors active to see if we can detect any sign of the rest of the UE Fleet. Hopefully we won't run out of warp fuel before we can either find a suitable planet, or a new fuel source that is compatible to our warp drive.

-Captain Dominguez
Chinese (simplified):
到达日志，条目1

将我们送到这里的神秘异常似乎要么是单向的，要么已经坍缩，要么是个移动异常。我们的传感器上没有任何迹象，因此我们返回自己星系的机会似乎不大。

考虑到这一点，我决定开始寻找一个合适的地点建立新殖民地，同时保持传感器活跃，看看能否探测到UE舰队其他部分的任何迹象。希望在我们找到合适的星球或与我们的翘曲引擎兼容的新燃料源之前，翘曲燃料不会耗尽。

——多明戈斯船长

Medical Log, Entry 2

With so little medical supplies on hand, I'm not sure we should be the ones responding to a distress call. However, since we ARE trying to locate the rest of the fleet, and this at least seems to be a United Earth signal we're receiving, I don't see we have much choice.

I've been gathering what little supplies we do have, and believe we are ready to help, as best we can. The uncertainty of the signa's origin aside, I'm hopeful that we do, indeed, find one of the other ships from our fleet.

-Doctor Schneider

我一直在收集我们仅有的少量物资，并相信我们已经准备好尽力提供帮助。尽管信号来源不确定，但我希望我们确实能找到我们舰队中的另一艘飞船。

-施耐德医生

English:
*whispering* Medical Log, Entry 3

It's been nearly a day since the aliens boarded the ship. The first group set up some sort of teleport pads in the Engine Room, and more have been teleporting in ever since their ships left. 

A few hours ago, they began removing the crew from their cryo chambers. Most of them were executed instantly, but a few were taken away, presumably to be held prisoner... or worse.

I've been hiding in one of the empty cryo chambers, hoping they're too stupid to re-check the ones they already emptied. If I could somehow get one of their weapons, perhaps I could destroy the teleport pads and prevent more from boarding. if only... shit... no. *Cryo Chamber Opens* *Sreaming* NOOOOO!!!!!!!!!! *Alien growls and snarls*

*shotgun blast* *End of Log*

几小时前，他们开始将船员从冷冻舱中取出。大多数被立即处决，但少数被带走，可能是作为囚犯...或者更糟。

我一直躲在一个空的冷冻舱里，希望他们愚蠢到不会重新检查已经清空的舱室。如果我能搞到他们的一件武器，也许就能摧毁传送器垫，阻止更多人登船。要是...操...不。 *冷冻舱打开* *尖叫* 不！！！！！！ *外星人咆哮和怒吼*

*霰弹枪射击* *日志结束*

Helmsman Log, Entry 1

Apart from our location being over two million lightyears from where we were, something else seems off. I can't exactly put my finger on it, but the stars and galaxies seem... off... somehow. Nobody from earth has ever seen the universe from this galaxy, so that's maybe it. 

The Captain wants us to try to continue our mission, despite the absence of the rest of the fleet. She believes that the rest of the fleet will find us, or we will find them, and somehow being stranded in an alien galaxy won't get us killed.
I wish I were so optimistic.

-Ensign Neibuhr, Helmsman

船长希望我们尽管舰队其他部分失踪，仍尽力继续任务。她相信其余舰队会找到我们，或者我们会找到他们，并且不知怎地，被困在外星星系不会让我们丧命。
但愿我也能如此乐观。

-少尉尼布尔，舵手

English:
Helmsman Log, Entry 2

It seems the captain's optimism was well founded. We seem to have picked up a distress signal coming from a nearby system. However, even though the frequency appears to be a United Earth frequency, the signal itself is unfamiliar to me. It's obviously a distress call, but it's not encoded with the ID of any of the ships of our fleet. In fact, based on the data that IS encoded, it seems to be from no ship at all... or at least not one that had been constructed before we left Earth.

-Ensign Neibuhr, Helmsman

English:

I'm all alone. The only one left. Captain Dominguez managed to eject Cargo Module One, but was immediately gunned down by one of those aliens. I managed to lock the door to the Cargo Connector and ejected Cryo Module Four to prevent them from reaching me, but I don't know what to do from here. The Oxygen Suits are stored in Cargo Module Two, which I'm cut off from, and I'm sure to starve if I wait long enough. 

*tearful sobbing* It seems my only choices are to be killed by one of those... things... or a slow death from starvation. Actually... there is a third option. If anyone wakes up from Cryo Stasis and reads this, the unlock code to the Cargo Connector is: 8176 

*more sobbing* Um... oh, I managed to take out one of them that came through Cryo Four before I could eject it. I hid it's weapon and ammo in a storage locker behind the Gravity Generator in Cryo Module Two. I'm not much of a fighter, but perhaps you will have more luck.

-Ensign Neibuhr, Helmsman, Final Entry... *Exterior Door Opens* *Exterior Door Closes*

English:
Arrival Log, Entry 1

Upon arriving beyond the anomaly, we find ourselves in a strange star system in another galaxy, over six hundred years in our future. But at least we’re alive. We don’t know where any of the other ships of the fleet are, or if they even survived, so we must carry on alone.

Our sensors have detected some sort of large derelict vessel at the edge of this system. We have set course to it and should arrive at its location within the hour. All readings indicate that the vessel is adrift, with no life signs or power signatures. Perhaps we can find something useful on board. Either way, this system seems to have a habitable planet nearby, one we can set down on and start a new colony.

-Captain Alonso Hooke
Chinese (simplified):
到达日志，条目1

穿越异常后，我们发现自己身处另一个星系的一个奇怪恒星系中，时间比我们原本的未来早了六百多年。但至少我们还活着。我们不知道舰队其他飞船在哪里，也不知道它们是否幸存，所以我们必须独自前行。

我们的传感器在这个星系边缘探测到某种大型废弃飞船。我们已设定航线，应在一小时内到达其位置。所有读数都显示该飞船漂浮着，没有生命迹象或能量信号。也许我们能在船上找到有用之物。无论如何，这个星系附近似乎有一颗宜居星球，我们可以降落并开始建立新殖民地。

- 阿隆索·胡克船长

English:
Arrival Log, Entry 2

Investigating the derelict ship was a mistake. As soon as we were within sight of it, it powered up with some sort of mysterious energy causing it to become illuminated by an eerie green light. Its weapons sprang to life and began pummeling us while the wreckage, somehow, began to move toward us.
Ensign Tsukumo called it a Funayūrei, and I agree; this is some kind of Ghost Ship. 
We've managed to evade our persuer by taking refuge in the upper atmosphere of a nearby gas giant. While the temperature outside the ship is over 200 degrees, and the radiation levels are intense, the ship should protect us, for now.

-Captain Alonso Hooke
Chinese (simplified):
到达日志，条目2

调查那艘废弃飞船是个错误。我们刚一进入视野，它就启动了一种神秘能量，发出诡异的绿光。它的武器突然开火并开始猛击我们，同时残骸竟开始向我们移动。
筑紫少尉称之为"船幽灵"，我同意；这是一艘某种意义上的幽灵船。
我们设法躲进了附近一颗巨型气态行星的高层大气中，以躲避追击者。虽然飞船外部温度超过200度，辐射水平强烈，但飞船暂时应该能保护我们。

- 阿隆索·胡克船长

English:
Arrival Log, Entry 3

It's been two weeks since Engineer Doohan completed his "Fukushima Escape" Shuttle, which he cobbled together from various parts of the Ship. I didn't think he could do it, but he proved me wrong yet again. We began shuttling passengers down to a nearby Temperate Planet just over a week ago. Now, we're loading the last of the passengers from the Cryo Chambers into the shuttle, and I will finally be joining them down on the planet. 
The passengers... I suppose they're colonists now... have constructed what they dubbed "Fukushima Colony" around what appears to be an old Emergency Shelter. They set up a variety of pre-fabricated habitats, as well as a small warehouse.
As we shuttled more personnel down, they began building separate farming settlements a short distance away. With nearly three hundred settlers, we should be able to survive. Perhaps others from the fleet will find us, and join us.

-Captain Alonso Hooke
Chinese (simplified):
到达日志，条目3

自从工程师杜汉完成了他的"福岛逃生"穿梭机（用飞船的各种部件拼凑而成）已经两周了。我原以为他做不到，但他再次证明我错了。大约一周前，我们开始将乘客运送到附近的一个温带星球。现在，我们正将最后一批乘客从低温舱装载到穿梭机上，我也终于要和他们一起降落到星球上了。
乘客们……我想他们现在是殖民者了……在似乎是旧应急避难所周围建造了他们称之为"福岛殖民地"的定居点。他们搭建了各种预制栖息地，以及一个小仓库。
随着我们运送更多人员下去，他们在不远处开始建造独立的农业定居点。拥有近三百名定居者，我们应该能生存下去。也许舰队中的其他人会找到我们，加入我们。

- 阿隆索·胡克船长

English:
Engineer Log, Entry 1

He's Crazy! We've just awakened fro' Cryo Stasis Millions o' Lightyears away from our own galaxy, an' hundreds o' years in th' future, an' what's th' first thing th' Cap'n does? He sets course fer a bloody haunted space wreck, nearly gets us killed, an' decides t' hide us in a bloody gas giant!
When I signed up fer this mission, I 'ad no idea I was signin' on fer a suicide mission, let alone one led by a madman!

Now tha Cap'n's askin' me t' build a bloody escape shuttle out of whatever scraps of junk we 'ave on board! "It cannae be done!" I told him, but did 'e listen? No. O' course not. So now I'm gonna 'ave t' take apart some o' th' thrusters from th' hull of th' ship, in temperatures over two-hundred degrees! It's a good thing we've got one o' th' Large Constructors on board, otherwise we'd 'ave no chance!

- Engineer Doohan
Chinese (simplified):
工程师日志，条目1

他疯了！我们刚从低温静止状态中醒来，位于距离我们自己星系数百万光年、未来数百年的地方，而船长做的第一件事是什么？他驶向一个该死的闹鬼太空残骸，差点害死我们，然后决定把我们藏在一个该死的巨型气态行星里！
当我报名参加这次任务时，我根本不知道自己在报名自杀任务，更不用说由疯子领导的任务了！

现在船长让我用船上任何可用的破烂零件建造一个该死的逃生穿梭机！"这做不到！"我告诉他，但他听了吗？不，当然没有。所以现在我不得不拆下飞船船体的一些推进器，在超过两百度的温度下工作！幸好我们船上有一个大型建造机，否则我们一点机会都没有！

- 工程师杜汉

English:
Engineer Log, Entry 2

I managed t' scrape t'gether enough materials t' make an Environmental Suit that 'as provide me enough protection from tha heat an' radiation t' allow me t' salvage what we need from tha outside o' tha ship. I managed t' disassemble several o' tha ship's thrusters, along with some o' tha antenna arrays an' sensor dishes. I've also managed to cobble t'gether enough steel plates to begin workin' on an escape shuttle. 

In order t' start work on tha shuttle, I 'ad to ask Doctor Kelley to completely disassemble 'is medical module. Ye can imagine 'ow 'appy 'e was t' comply. Once we're done with tha' shuttle, We should be able t' start ferryin' passengers t' tha nearby planet. No' tha' there's any guarantee it's safer than out 'ere.

- Engineer Doohan
Chinese (simplified):
工程师日志，条目2

我设法凑齐了足够的材料制作了一套环境防护服，它为我提供了足够的热量和辐射保护，让我能从飞船外部回收我们需要的东西。我拆解了几个飞船的推进器，以及一些天线阵列和传感器碟形天线。我还拼凑了足够的钢板来开始建造逃生穿梭机。

为了开始建造穿梭机，我不得不让凯莉医生完全拆解他的医疗模块。你可以想象他有多么不情愿配合。等穿梭机完工，我们应该就能开始将乘客运送到附近的星球。不过不能保证那里比这里更安全。

- 工程师杜汉

English:
Engineer Log, Entry 3

I'm surprised a' 'ow smoothly tha evacuation went. We've nearly evacuated tha entire ship an' 'ave only one trip t' go. Before I leave on tha final trip, I'm settin' tha ship's power systems t' minimal, an' programin' it t' re-activate if anyone enters tha engineering compartment, jus' incase anyone from the fleet comes lookin' fer us.

- Engineer Doohan
Chinese (simplified):
工程师日志，条目3

我很惊讶撤离进行得这么顺利。我们几乎撤空了整艘飞船，只剩最后一趟了。在我出发进行最后一次飞行前，我会将飞船的电力系统设为最低，并编程让它如果有人进入工程舱就重新启动，以防舰队有人来找我们。

- 工程师杜汉

English:
Medical Log, Entry 1

The effects of the strange anomaly on the crew seem to have been minimal, thank God. I know we had no way of avoiding it, but who knows what kind of radiation we've all been exposed to, traveling through time and space like that. It's not natural. In any case, I've prepared the Medical Module as best I can to begin reviving the passengers when the time comes. The Captain seems interested in getting us killed by chasing some damned derelict ship, rather than the sensible thing of setting course for the ONLY habitable planet on sensors. It's his call though. God forbid he should curb his curiosity.

- Doctor Kelley
Chinese (simplified):
医疗日志，条目1

谢天谢地，那个奇怪异常对船员的影响似乎很小。我知道我们无法避免它，但谁知道我们在那样穿越时空的过程中暴露在了什么辐射下。这违背自然。无论如何，我已经尽力准备好了医疗模块，以便在时机到来时开始复苏乘客。船长似乎对追逐一艘该死的废弃飞船很感兴趣，而不是做明智的事——向传感器上唯一的宜居星球设定航线。但这是他的决定。但愿他能克制自己的好奇心。

- 凯莉医生

English:
Medical Log, Entry 2

I told The Captain not to take unnecessary risks! But did he listen? No, of course not. Now we're stuck hiding in some goddamned gas giant, being exposed to God knows how much radiation, the temperature of the hull of the ship building, waiting for some damned flying wreck to find and kill us. The rest of the crew thinks the hulking wreckage is haunted, but I recon it's just on some kind of auto-pilot that we accidentally activated by poking our noses where they don't belong. Either way, here we are. Now I've got to make sure that the crew doesn't die of radiation exposure while we wait to be killed by our own stupidity.

- Doctor Kelley
Chinese (simplified):
医疗日志，条目2

我告诉船长不要冒不必要的风险！但他听了吗？不，当然没有。现在我们被困在某个该死的巨型气态行星里躲避，暴露在不知多少辐射中，飞船船体温度升高，等待着某个该死的飞行残骸找到并杀死我们。其他船员认为那庞大的残骸闹鬼，但我认为它只是某种自动驾驶模式，是我们多管闲事时意外激活的。不管怎样，我们在这里。现在我必须确保船员在等待被自己的愚蠢杀死之前，不会死于辐射暴露。

- 凯莉医生

English:
Medical Log, Entry 3

At Engineer Doohan's request, I've disassembled all the medical equipment in the Medical Module, which he has now converted into a makeshift shuttle bay. He’s been steadily working to use salvaged parts of the ship to build an escape shuttle. Waste of time if you ask me.
The shuttle will only be able to hold just over one Cryo Module of passengers, and Captain Hooke suggested I accompany the first group to the nearby planet, to reassemble the medical facility planet side in case there are any unforeseen medical issues while the first modular settlement is being erected. With that flying deathtrap out there, it sounds like a great way to get ourselves killed.

- Doctor Kelley
Chinese (simplified):
医疗日志，条目3

应工程师杜汉的要求，我拆解了医疗模块中的所有医疗设备，他现在已将其改装成了临时穿梭机库。他一直在稳步利用飞船的回收零件建造逃生穿梭机。依我看，这是浪费时间。
这架穿梭机只能容纳略多于一个低温舱的乘客，胡克船长建议我陪同第一批人员前往附近的星球，在地面重新组装医疗设施，以防在第一批模块化定居点搭建时出现任何不可预见的医疗问题。在这架飞行死亡陷阱外面，这简直是个自杀的好方法。

- 凯莉医生

English:
Helmsman Log, Entry 2

In the ancient legends of my ancestors, the Funayūrei are spirits of the dead that, among other things, possess the husks of shipwrecks and attempt to sink any other ships they come across. I never believed such things, until now.  As we approached the derelict ship, it began to glow with an unnatural green light, and came to life. Its first volley of weapons fire damaged a good portion of the hull, but I managed to evade them quickly enough to avoid a hull breach. 

Captain Hooke the course set toward the gas giant in this system. His hope is that we can take refuge just inside its upper atmosphere and avoid the Funayūrei that pursues us. There's no guarantee that our assailant won't simply follow us, but I am sworn to follow orders, and that's what I shall do.

- Ensign Tsukumo, Helmsman
Chinese (simplified):
舵手日志，条目2

在我的祖先的古老传说中，船幽灵是死者的灵魂，它们会附身于失事船只的残骸，并试图击沉它们遇到的任何其他船只。我从未相信过这些传说，直到现在。当我们接近那艘废弃飞船时，它开始发出不自然的绿光，并活了过来。它的第一轮武器火力损坏了船体相当一部分，但我及时躲避，避免了船体破裂。

胡克船长将航向设定为这个星系的气态巨行星。他希望我们能躲在其上层大气层内，避开追击我们的船幽灵。无法保证袭击者不会跟着我们，但我发誓服从命令，这就是我要做的。

——少尉九十九，舵手

English:
Helmsman Log, Entry 3

Engineer Doohan finally completed the Escape Shuttle, and christened it the "Fukushima Escape". Captain Hooke assigned me to fly the shuttle to and from an apparently habitable planet that we detected in the system. The first trip to this planet went relatively smoothly. In addition to the thirty-five passengers that were revived from the first Cryo-Module, Doctor Kelley also joined us for the trip. 

When we first entered the atmosphere, our sensors detected several abandoned and destroyed structures and vehicles. One of the structures, a Destroyed Shelter, was selected to act as the foundation of our new settlement, now called "Fukushima Colony". 
Now that we've completed our final trip, we can begin worrying about living, rather than just surviving.

- Ensign Tsukumo, Helmsman
Chinese (simplified):
舵手日志，条目3

工程师杜汉终于完成了逃生穿梭机，并命名为“福岛逃生号”。胡克船长指派我驾驶穿梭机往返于我们在该星系探测到的一颗看似宜居的星球。第一次前往这颗星球的旅程相对顺利。除了从第一个低温模块中苏醒的三十五名乘客外，凯利医生也加入了这次旅行。

当我们首次进入大气层时，传感器探测到几处废弃和毁坏的建筑及车辆。其中一处毁坏庇护所被选作新定居点——现称“福岛殖民地”——的基础。
如今我们完成了最后一次旅程，可以开始操心如何生活，而不仅仅是生存了。

——少尉九十九，舵手

English:
Colony Log, Entry 1

It's been five days since we first arrived on this planet. I, Commander Jordan Holch, have been appointed by Captain Hooke as the Colonial Governor of Fukushima Colony, responsible for overseeing the construction and expansion of the colony. The third shuttle load of passengers has just arrived, many of which are agricultural specialists keen on setting up farming villages on the outskirts of the colony.  However, until we get the main settlement set up, and the walls around it erected, I'm not willing to allow anyone to travel too far away.

By my estimation, it will take another five days to complete the main settlement, using the Colonial Prefabs we have available. They were really meant to work in conjunction with transforming the Fukushima and her Modules into habitats as well, but we'll do the best we can with what we have. We've set up crude power systems with each Prefab, but hopefully once Engineer Doohan arrives, he will be able to set up a unified power grid.

- Commander Jordan Holch,  Colonial Governor
Chinese (simplified):
殖民地日志，条目1

自我们首次抵达这颗星球已经过去五天。我，指挥官乔丹·霍尔奇，被胡克船长任命为福岛殖民地的殖民地总督，负责监督殖民地的建设和扩张。第三批穿梭机乘客刚刚抵达，其中许多是农业专家，渴望在殖民地外围建立农业村庄。然而，在主定居点建成并竖起围墙之前，我不允许任何人走得太远。

据我估计，还需要五天时间才能利用现有的殖民地预制件完成主定居点。这些预制件本应配合改造福岛号及其模块成为栖息地，但我们会尽力利用现有条件。我们为每个预制件搭建了简陋的电力系统，但希望工程师杜汉到达后能建立统一的电网。

——指挥官乔丹·霍尔奇，殖民地总督

English:
Colony Log, Entry 2

Setting up the Cargo Deck was a lot more time consuming than we expected. While the initial setup wasn't that difficult, it took us nearly two days to gather the resources needed to set up the Constructors we will need for mass fabrication of parts for the rest of the colony. Even once they were online, our limited resources on this planet make it difficult to stockpile what we need. As such, a large portion of the upper level of the Cargo Deck is currently empty.

The final shuttle with Captain Hooke and Engineer Doohan on board are due to arrive tomorrow morning. Perhaps once they arrive, we'll be able to start work on the Farming Settlements, as it's already overcrowded here.

- Commander Jordan Holch,  Colonial Governor
Chinese (simplified):
殖民地日志，条目2

搭建货运甲板比我们预期的耗时得多。虽然初始搭建并不困难，但我们花了将近两天时间收集所需资源，以便设置建造殖民地其他部分所需零件的大型构造器。即使它们上线后，这颗星球上有限的资源也难以让我们储备所需物资。因此，货运甲板上层目前有很大一部分是空的。

搭载胡克船长和工程师杜汉的最后一架穿梭机将于明天早上抵达。也许他们到达后，我们就能开始农业定居点的工作，因为这里已经过于拥挤了。

——指挥官乔丹·霍尔奇，殖民地总督

English:
Colony Log, Entry 4

There have been a rash of disappearances throughout the colony. It started in the outlying Farming Settlements, a few hunters disappeared while out hunting at night. Search parties in the morning couldn't find any trace of the hunters. Soon, anyone who went out after night would just.... vanish. Colonists within the settlements are getting more and more paranoid, accusing each other of various betrayals. Last night, we had our first disappearance within the main settlement. The unnerving thing is that the woman who disappeared was last seen walking toward the settlement exit, but the gate logs say the gate remained closed all night. Either she climbed the nearly perfectly flat wall... or she somehow got through the gate without opening it...

- Commander Jordan Holch,  Colonial Governor
Chinese (simplified):
殖民地日志，条目4

殖民地最近发生了一系列失踪事件。始于偏远的农业定居点，几个猎人在夜间打猎时失踪。早上的搜索队找不到任何猎人的踪迹。很快，任何在夜间外出的人都会……消失。定居点内的殖民者越来越偏执，互相指责各种背叛行为。昨晚，主定居点出现了第一起失踪案。令人不安的是，那名失踪女子最后一次被看到是走向定居点出口，但大门日志显示大门整夜关闭。要么她爬上了几乎完全平整的墙壁……要么她以某种方式在不打开大门的情况下穿过了大门……

——指挥官乔丹·霍尔奇，殖民地总督

English:
Colony Log, Entry 5

There's everywhere now... In the trees, in the walls, in the air, in my mind. I can't tell what is real and what is not, I fear that the others are all mad, driven so by whatever those things are that followed us from the Fukushima. I'm the only one not affected by... whatever they are. But they won't get me...
They won't... THEY WON'T GET ME!!!!! YOU HEAR ME!!! YOU WON'T GET ME!!!!! 
They won't... *GUNSHOT*

*END OF LOG*
Chinese (simplified):
殖民地日志，条目5

现在到处都是……在树林里，在墙壁里，在空气中，在我的脑海里。我分不清什么是真实，什么不是。我担心其他人都疯了，被那些从福岛号跟来的东西逼疯了。我是唯一不受……它们影响的人。但它们抓不到我……
它们抓不到……你们听见了吗！！！你们抓不到我！！
它们抓不到…… *枪声*

*日志结束*

English:
Colonial Engineering Log, Entry 1

After arrivin' on th' plane' after our las' trip from th' ship, th' Cap'n and Commander Holch tasked me with upgradin' th' colony's power systems. My first goal will be t' install a series o' solar panels atop the Cargo Deck, an' connect 'em t' th' colony's main power grid, and connect all tha' habitats power systems t'gether.
This'll probably take th' better part o' tha week, so I be'er ge' started a' soon as I can.

- Engineer Doohan
Chinese (simplified):
殖民地工程日志，条目1

上次从飞船抵达这颗星球后，船长和霍尔奇指挥官命令我升级殖民地的动力系统。我的首要目标是在货运甲板顶部安装一系列太阳能板，将它们连接到殖民地的主电网，并连通所有栖息地的动力系统。

——工程师杜汉

English:
Colonial Engineering Log, Entry 2

'ere's somthin' wrong wi' tha power o' this plane'. I cannae fig'r ou' wha' i' is. I's like th' bloo'y a'mospere eats energy. I dunnae. I've been tryin' t' se' up th' solar power t' one o' th' outlyin' farms, an' I cannae ge' th' damn thing t' do right. It's as if th' light 'ere is a li'l drained. I' may be somethin' t'do with th' sun... I' seems dimmer tha' usual...

- Engineer Doohan
Chinese (simplified):
殖民地工程日志，条目2

这颗星球的动力系统有问题。我搞不明白是怎么回事。就好像这该死的大气在吞噬能量。我不知道。我一直在试着给其中一个外围农场安装太阳能板，但就是弄不好。仿佛这里的光线被削弱了一点。这可能跟太阳有关……它似乎比平常更暗……

——工程师杜汉

English:
Medical Log, Entry 1

When the captain told me I'd be one of the first to help set up the colony, I was happy to get off that blasted ship, to feel the cool breeze on my face, and to breath fresh air. However, over the last week, as more and more people arrive, it seems that the sky is always cloudy, the wind blows less and less, and the air seems to have a... metallic taste. 
Something's wrong with this damned planet. On top of all that, people seem to be getting more paranoid than usual: Shadows moving out of the corner of the eye, strange noises in the woods, a feeling of being watched. Obviously something on this planet is causing hallucinations, but I've tested the water, air, and soil, and I can't find anything, toxins, microbes, spores, anything that can explain it.

At night, even I feel as if there's prying eyes everywhere. While I don't feel any other effects that could be attributed to any toxins or aliment. While I don't feel as if my faculties are compromised, I have decided to maintain this log to catalogue my potential exposure for later review. If I am loosing my mind, perhaps this log will serve to aid others who may find us.

- Doctor Kelley
Chinese (simplified):
医疗日志，条目1

当船长告诉我将成为首批协助建立殖民地的成员时，我很高兴能离开那艘该死的飞船，感受脸上的凉风，呼吸新鲜空气。然而，在过去一周里，随着越来越多的人到来，天空似乎总是阴沉，风越来越小，空气中还带有……金属味。
这个该死的星球有问题。更糟的是，人们似乎比平常更偏执：眼角余光看到移动的影子，树林里奇怪的声音，被监视的感觉。显然，这个星球上的某些东西引起了幻觉，但我测试了水、空气和土壤，找不到任何毒素、微生物、孢子或其他可以解释的东西。

到了晚上，连我都觉得四处都有窥视的眼睛。虽然我感觉不到任何可能由毒素或疾病引起的其他影响，但我不觉得自己的智力受损。我决定记录这本日志，以记录可能的暴露情况，供日后审查。如果我疯了，也许这本日志能帮助那些可能找到我们的人。

——凯利医生

The wind is silent now... The forest is making strange noises... Like it's... alive... Like it's... angry...

风现在安静了……森林发出奇怪的声音……就像它……活着……就像它……愤怒……

English:
Arrival Log Entry 1

Upon emerging from the anomaly, the flight crew, including Ensign Steinman, our helmsman, Engineer Brown, Doctor Pong, and myself, were awakened from cryo-stasis. According to the ship's chronometer, we've only been in stasis for just over a year. 

However, based on an assessment of current astronomical positions from Ensign Steinman, We seem to have emerged from the anomaly some six hundred years after we left. Furthermore, our current position seems to be somewhere inside the Andromeda galaxy, which would have taken over a thousand years at warp. 

Despite this anomaly, I have decided that our best course of action is to try and assess our damages and ensure that the Cryo Chambers are all still functional.

- Captain Bodegar
Chinese (simplified):
抵达日志条目1

从异常中脱离后，飞行机组人员——包括舵手准尉斯坦曼、工程师布朗、庞医生和我——从冷冻睡眠中苏醒。根据飞船计时器，我们只休眠了刚刚超过一年。
然而，根据准尉斯坦曼对当前天文位置的评估，我们似乎在离开后约六百年才脱离异常。此外，我们当前位置似乎在仙女座星系内，而那里以翘曲速度航行需要一千多年。
尽管有这种异常，我决定我们最好的行动方案是尝试评估我们的损伤，并确保所有冷冻舱仍然运转。

——博德加船长

English:
Arrival Log Entry 2

The distress signal we've been broadcasting seems to have drawn some attention of some of the natives of this galaxy. Unfortunately, they're not the friendly sort. Three small space vessels opened fire on us and are now chasing us. Our sensors detect no life signs on board, so I can only assume they're automated drones of some sort.
We're running on auxiliary power, heading toward what appears to be an asteroid field. Hopefully we can loose our pursuers amidst the rocks. 

- Captain Bodegar
Chinese (simplified):
抵达日志条目2

我们一直在广播的求救信号似乎引起了本星系一些本土居民的注意。不幸的是，它们并不友好。三艘小型太空飞船向我们开火，并且正在追击我们。我们的传感器未探测到任何生命迹象，所以我只能假设它们是某种自动化无人机。
我们正依靠辅助动力航行，前往一片看似小行星带的地方。希望我们能在岩石中摆脱追兵。

——博德加船长

English:
Engineer's Log Entry 2

I've completed inventory of the cargo modules. It seems that most of the cargo survived the attack. The Captain has ordered us to take what we need and destroy the rest. I'm not sure how I feel about destroying such valuable cargo, but I do as I'm told.

- Engineer Brown
Chinese (simplified):
工程师日志条目2

我完成了货舱模块的盘点。大部分货物在袭击中幸存了下来。船长命令我们取走所需，销毁其余部分。我不确定自己对销毁如此有价值的货物有何感想，但我服从命令。

——工程师布朗

English:
Engineer's Notes

To activate the teleporter in the Cargo Module 1/2, power must be transferred to it. However, in order to transfer enough power, four Breakers must be flipped on. Once the circuit is complete, one must only stand on the teleporter to activate it. The problem is, two of the breakers are located in the nacelles, and one of the nacelle's access shafts is blocked by debris. If only I could find a way into that nacelle...

- Engineer Brown
Chinese (simplified):
工程师笔记

要激活货舱模块1/2中的传送器，必须向其输送能量。然而，要输送足够的能量，必须合上四个断路器。一旦电路完成，只需站在传送器上即可激活。问题是，其中两个断路器位于引擎舱内，而其中一个引擎舱的通道被碎片堵塞。要是我能找到进入那个引擎舱的办法……

——工程师布朗

English:
Engineer's Log Entry 3

We're abandoning ship, whatever good that will do. I fear we're just delivering us to a quicker death. I've transferred the remaining power to the cryo-pods, hopefully giving the occupants a chance. If only we could get the teleporter we brought working, we could make it out of here in one piece

- Engineer Brown

Note: It might be possible to re-route power to the teleporter. If only we had more time...
Chinese (simplified):
工程师日志条目3

我们要弃船了，不管这有什么好处。我担心这只会让我们更快走向死亡。我已经将剩余能量转移到冷冻舱，希望给里面的人一个机会。要是我们能启动带来的传送器就好了，这样我们就能毫发无损地离开这里。

——工程师布朗

备注：也许可以重新分配能量给传送器。要是我们有更多时间就好了……

English:
Medical Log, Entry 1

I've examined the CryoPods. About half of them have failed, and I expect another two-thirds of them will fail within the next few hours. Our power reserves are too low to begin reviving those who remained in stasis. Their only hope is to wake up on their own. I have accelerated the programmed Cryo-cycle so they will wake up in about ten years, rather than one hundred.

- Doctor Pong
Chinese (simplified):
医疗日志，条目1

我检查了冷冻舱。大约一半已经失效，我预计在未来几小时内还会有三分之二失效。我们的能量储备太低，无法开始唤醒那些仍处于休眠状态的人。他们唯一的希望是自行苏醒。我加速了设定的冷冻循环，这样他们大约会在十年后醒来，而不是一百年。

——庞医生

English:
Medical Log, Entry 2

We have multiple hull breaches throughout the ship. The drones chased us into an asteroid field, but they wouldn't leave. The captain has called for us to abandon ship. He's given me five minutes to find a way to save those remaining in Cryo Stasis. I can't even find a way for us to survive.

- Doctor Pong
Chinese (simplified):
医疗日志，条目2

飞船多处船体破裂。无人机追赶我们进入小行星带，但它们不肯离开。船长已下令弃船。他给了我五分钟时间想办法拯救那些仍在冷冻睡眠中的人。我甚至找不到让我们自己活下去的办法。

——庞医生

English:
Medical Log, Entry 3

I've had Engineer Brown transfer what power he can to the remaining Cryo Pods. Perhaps they will stand better a chance at survival than we do. We came out here looking for a new home, but all we found was death.  

- Doctor Pong
Chinese (simplified):
医疗日志，条目3

我已让工程师布朗尽可能多地将能量转移到剩余的冷冻舱。也许它们比我们更有机会存活。我们来到这里寻找新家园，但我们找到的只有死亡。

——庞医生

English:
Helmsman 's Log, Entry 1

I've double checked my calculations, triple checked them, and I've come to the unnerving conclusion that despite the ship's chronometer saying we've only been in stasis for eleven months, fifteen days and eighteen hours, Earth Standard Time obviously, we have somehow arrived six hundred years in our future, somewhere in the galaxy of Andromeda. we're currently running on auxiliary power, with most of our main power diverted to the remaining Cryo-Chambers to save what's left of our passengers. Until we can determine a course, the Captain has us holding position, broadcasting our distress signal at full strength. Perhaps the rest of the fleet will detect our signal and come looking for us.

- Ensign Steinman
Chinese (simplified):
舵手日志，条目1

我反复核对了我的计算，再三检查，得出了一个令人不安的结论：尽管飞船的计时器显示我们只冷冻休眠了十一个月十五天十八小时（当然是地球标准时间），但我们不知何故来到了六百年后的未来，位于仙女座星系的某处。我们目前依靠辅助动力运行，大部分主能量被转移到剩余的冷冻舱以挽救幸存的乘客。在确定航线之前，船长命令我们保持当前位置，全功率广播我们的求救信号。也许舰队的其他部分会探测到我们的信号并前来寻找我们。

——准尉斯坦曼

English:
Helmsman 's Log, Entry 2

The Captain has called for all hands to abandon ship. I feel bad for those who are being left in cryo-stasis, but there isn't much we can do for them now. If anybody wakes up and reads this, there are some rations and a space suit in Cargo Module One. The Code to the locker is 1-7-9-2.

- Ensign Steinman
Chinese (simplified):
舵手日志，条目2

船长下令全体弃船。我为那些被留在冷冻睡眠中的人感到难过，但我们现在做不了什么。如果有人醒来并读到这段文字，货舱模块一里有一些口粮和一套太空服。储物柜密码是1-7-9-2。

——准尉斯坦曼

English:
Engineer's Log Entry 1

The trip through the anomaly has left the ship no worse for wear, although our power reserves are low, and slowly dropping further. Much of the power drained has left many Cryo Chambers failing. While Doctor Pong assesses the state of the Cryo Chambers, I will be taking inventory of our supplies. With any luck, we should have what we need to fix the power drain. 

- Engineer Brown
Chinese (simplified):
工程师日志条目1

穿越异常的旅行并未给飞船造成更严重的损伤，尽管我们的能量储备很低，并且还在缓慢下降。大量能量流失导致许多冷冻舱失效。在庞医生评估冷冻舱状态的同时，我将盘点我们的补给。运气好的话，我们应该有修复能量泄漏所需的东西。

——工程师布朗

English:
Arrival Log Entry 3

The asteroid field we took refuge in concealed a hidden Starship Graveyard. Whether the sight of an ancient battle, or the dumping ground for some alien race, is impossible to tell without more in-depth analysis. Regardless of its origin, it seems this junk field will be the final resting place of the [c][3333e5]UES Rosignol[-][/c], as the drones have not only followed us into the field, but there were more waiting in ambush inside. We have no choice but to abandon ship, and pray that whatever cosmic forces reside in this galaxy watch over our passengers in Cryo Stasis until they revive on their own.

- Captain Bodegar
Chinese (simplified):
抵达日志条目3

我们避难的小行星带中隐藏着一片废弃飞船墓地。无论是古战场遗迹，还是某种外星种族的垃圾场，没有更深入的分析是无法确定的。无论其来源如何，这片废铁场似乎将成为[c][3333e5]UES罗西尼奥尔[-][/c]的最终安息地，因为无人机不仅跟随着我们进入了小行星带，而且内部还有更多埋伏等待着。我们别无选择，只能弃船，并祈求这个星系中存在的任何宇宙力量能够保护我们冷冻睡眠中的乘客，直到他们自行苏醒。

——博德加船长

English:
This barren, rocky planet, keeps nearest to its star... - Which is a bit too close for comfort. Its day side is heated near to the melting point, while the night side radiates into the vacuum of space. This constant temperature stress leaves deep scars in the surface, and fuels the growth of exotic crystals.

During youth, this world even had part of its crust boiled away - Placing the heavy mantle deposits in scanner range - ... But you will need all your calm, skill and experience to collect them. - Lest it becomes a greedy miner's grave: Slowly being cooked in your own, stuck vessel!

This galaxy is huge. - - There are plenty of easier worlds to exploit, or home shores to settle.People still attracted to such murderous places could be of the unstable, dangerous kind:

[i]The foolish, the violent, the crazy, the lawless...[/i]

Ducking away, underground or in the shadows- Escaping the glare of the day... while their bases crumble and groan by the stretching of metal.
